dialogues.speaker: Ekbert
dialogues.text: That's my younger sister, and she still lives over in Springvale. She used to feed me a whole heap of wild vegetables to sober me up whenever I drank too much.

dialogues.speaker: Ekbert
dialogues.text: ...It's not like she even had enough wild vegetables for herself. *sigh* And now I miss her wild vegetable soup.

dialogues.speaker: Ekbert
dialogues.text: If you have the time, Honorary Knight... would you do me the favor of dropping in on her the next time you pass by Springvale?
